How do I use it properly the very first time?
To use your AIR DEFENDER properly the very first time, start by giving it a full charge with the included charging cable until the indicator shows it is complete.
Place the earmuffs over your ears and adjust the headband so the cushions fit snugly and completely seal around your ears. A tight, comfortable seal is key to getting full 24 dB hearing protection.
Power them on, turn on Bluetooth on your device, and select AIR DEFENDER to pair. You can adjust the playback volume directly from your phone or device, and SafeMax™ Technology will keep output within safe limits.
